about: Which of the game's rendered songs and effects the web demo and the engine (engine/, marked engine/) use, and why. Facts only; the audio itself is rendered from the ROM by tools/render_audio.py and encoded by tools/export_web.py.

music.why: docs/emulation.md: the hole of course 1 requests $89 through sub_spc_play_song, id = $7E + n, so song 11. Loop points come from build/spc/wav/index.tsv.
